kapak.alt: The Weber test and conductive loss

youtube.baslik: Why does sound seem louder in the poorer ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the Weber test, the tuning fork is placed on the middle of the forehead. In a one-sided conductive loss, the sound is heard in the poorer ear, because room noise masks it less there; in a one-sided sensorineural loss, the sound shifts to the better ear.
